assertion: An event exists, described as "Ebola treatment trial begins in DR Congo".
judge_quote: A trial of potential treatments for the species of virus behind the current deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has begun, the World Health Organization (WHO) has announced.
evidence_cited: A trial of potential treatments for the species of virus behind the current deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has begun, the World Health Organization (WHO) has announced.
The first patient has been enrolled in DR Congo, WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on Thursday.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Ebola outbreak in DR Congo".
judge_quote: The current outbreak of Ebola in DR Congo began in May, though transmission had been going undetected for some time.
evidence_cited: The current outbreak of Ebola in DR Congo began in May, though transmission had been going undetected for some time.
There have also been 20 confirmed cases in Uganda, leading to two deaths, and one confirmed case in France, as of 1 July.

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Confirmed cases in DR Congo".
judge_quote: More than 1,400 cases and 438 deaths have been confirmed in the country, according to the WHO.
evidence_cited: More than 1,400 cases and 438 deaths have been confirmed in the country, according to the WHO.
According to the WHO, 213 people have recovered.

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Confirmed cases in Uganda".
judge_quote: There have also been 20 confirmed cases in Uganda, leading to two deaths, and one confirmed case in France, as of 1 July.
evidence_cited: There have also been 20 confirmed cases in Uganda, leading to two deaths, and one confirmed case in France, as of 1 July.

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Outbreak restricted to eastern provinces".
judge_quote: Congolese health authorities have said the outbreak is currently restricted to three eastern provinces - South Kivu, North Kivu and Ituri.
evidence_cited: Congolese health authorities have said the outbreak is currently restricted to three eastern provinces - South Kivu, North Kivu and Ituri.

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Pregnant woman's body transported to Kisangani".
judge_quote: The Reuters and AFP news agencies report that the body of a pregnant woman tested positive for Ebola in the neighbouring Tshopo province. The woman reportedly died in Ituri, before her body was transported by motorbike to Tshopo's main city, Kisangani...
evidence_cited: The Reuters and AFP news agencies report that the body of a pregnant woman tested positive for Ebola in the neighbouring Tshopo province. The woman reportedly died in Ituri, before her body was transported by motorbike to Tshopo's main city, Kisangani, which has a population of about 1.5 million people.

assertion: An observation exists, described as "Ebola-positive individual fled to Haut-Uele".

evidence_cited: An individual suspected of having Ebola reportedly fled from an isolation unit in Ituri and later tested positive in the nearby Haut-Uele province.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Contact-tracing efforts launched in Tshopo and Haut-Uele".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Public gatherings banned in four provinces".

evidence_cited: Public gatherings were banned in both these provinces, along with neighbouring Bas-Uele and the capital, Kinshsasa, in order to prevent the spread of Ebola.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Outbreak could be one of the largest ever".
